offering_description.value: Provides broadband internet, wireless, voice, video and data services to consumers, businesses, carriers and government customers across Alaska. It owns and operates the fiber, cable, wireless and subsea network infrastructure that delivers these services.

primary_products.value: broadband internet access; wireless plans and devices; cable video; network equipment for business customers

primary_services.value: wireless service; broadband internet service; data and managed network services; voice services; wholesale capacity and backhaul

customer_segment.value: B2C: Alaska households buying internet, wireless and video; B2B: Alaska businesses, rural carriers, and healthcare and education institutions; B2G: Federal, state and local government agencies, including rural healthcare and school programs

end_markets.value: telecommunications; residential broadband; enterprise networking; rural healthcare and education connectivity; government

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly fees for broadband, wireless, video and voice service; service fees: managed network, data and wholesale capacity services to businesses and carriers; product sales: phones and customer equipment; other: government support funds for rural broadband and connectivity
revenue_model.category: subscription; service fees; product sales; other

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs fiber, cable, wireless and subsea networks, selling to consumers, businesses, carriers and government; service provider: retail and wholesale telecom services built on purchased equipment and content

geography_served.value: US regional: Alaska, including rural and remote communities

specialization.value: related lines: wireless, broadband, video, voice and business data services on shared networks

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company retail stores in Alaska; direct sales: sales teams for business, carrier and government accounts; online: website and online ordering

regulatory_exposure.value: high: telecom licensed spectrum and networks regulated by the FCC and Regulatory Commission of Alaska, universal service funding rules

notes: The original GCI Liberty merged into Liberty Broadband in 2020; a new GCI Liberty was spun off in 2025. Description covers the current Alaska telecom business.
divestiture_lines: P2.19: Liberty Broadband Corporation and GCI Liberty, Inc. completes the spin-off of GCI Liberty from Liberty Broadband.
